strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed. 2. Enemy enters the Anaheim facility before Lieutenant Kou Uraki returns.
Huh, where's Big Bro Kou?
Uraki went to Anaheim to pick up a new model.
The third Gundam prototype.
He's still not back? Can't he just pick it up and go already?
It's not like you stamp a form and you're done.
We'll just have to wait.
Sure, but...
Zeon must know we're here, right?
Instead of chasing the colony directly, we went out of our way
to come to Anaheim. They're bound to have noticed...
...Captain, shouldn't we deploy our forces, just in case?
Yes... All right, all ships on alert. Anyone who can launch, launch!
Captain! Something on radar!
Dammit, they show up the second we say it!
So they came! Only the bad predictions come true.
Here they come.
I see, so there was a reason you came here instead of chasing the colony...
It seems you have a secret plan to turn the tables...!
...!! Mashymre? It's Mashymre! Don't get in our way!
Judau Ashta, I cannot allow that...!
For Lady Haman's sake, in this Operation Stardust,
every uncertain factor must be eliminated, no matter how trivial!
You deluded, stuck-up creep! Nobody asked for you!
Ahh~ Telling his type won't get through to him.
Bah, how tiresome! Attack Londo Bell, and destroy
the new model being built at Anaheim! Go!
Uh-oh... They've set their sights on Gundam Unit 3!
All units, keep the enemy out of Anaheim till Lieutenant Uraki returns!
Uraki... We'll hold them here. Hurry back...!
Geez... After all this buildup, it'd better not be some cheap toy!
Right, let's do this!
(The all-purpose Unit 1, the nuclear Unit 2... and the next prototype...
Just what kind of machine is it...?)
No need to wait for any new weapon! Let's do this!
Wh-What is it!? This huge energy reading...!?
What...? Something's... coming!?
Wh-What the hell is this...? Isn't that a town!?
Narrow main roads and low buildings... This is a Japanese town!
Whoa... What is this? A town just appeared out of nowhere!?
It looks like... some town in Japan...
What... is going on here?
Don't tell me... a town-shaped Bomb!?
What would be the point of that shape? But... what's going on?
That light just now... didn't it look like a warp beam?
The kind Dr. Tarsan uses, Mia?
A warp? Like, the thing that gets you far away in an instant?
I've never even heard of something like that.
What...? An Earthling base this close!?
Blast those Meganoids, building defective junk!
Where... are we? Joe!
Damn you, Ilboraaa! Where the hell are we!
Heh, what does it matter where?
At the very least... this will be your grave!
Hey, Big Bro, could this be... the moon!?
What!? ...Come to think of it...
That's right! Isn't that Anaheim Electronics!?
Exactly, this is the lunar surface! I meant to blast you to Mars, but...
Die here, Joe!
What an elaborate setup! You didn't need all that, I'd fight you anyway!
Huh!? That unit over there...
Could it be Londo Bell!?
Hmm!? Wasn't that robot over there with the Gandor unit?
Ah! Joe and the others!?
That voice... Mia Alice!? Then it is Londo Bell!
What are you doing here!?
I'd like to know that too! Seems we fell for a trap, but this is overkill!
Londo Bell... You mean the Elshank hasn't joined you!?
That's right! The princess, is Princess Romina safe!?
Good timing, maybe. We were gonna go get 'em once we're done here.
After all this scheming, I won't leave empty-handed! Joe! Prepare yourself!
Looks like things have gotten all complicated,
but we've gotta protect this base, no matter what. Lend us a hand!
You don't have to ask!
We'll scatter 'em in one go and go get Princess Romina!
Looks like we've got another hothead...
That's...!?
Wow! Could that be...!?
Tobikage!
Looks like it's lending a hand.
Thanks, Tobikage! You sure are diligent! Coming all the way out here!
Wh-Whaaat!?
Ilbora! You dragged us all the way out here!
Give it a rest!
Silence! Damn, it won't move how I want! With the Skeleton...
can I no longer beat them!?
We'll settle this here!
I'll withdraw for now! But don't think this is over!
Ah, he ran away!
Tch, that Ilbora...
where'd he get such an insane device...!?
Am I late!? Sorry, everyone!
You're late, Uraki! ...But good job making it in time.
No kidding, Lieutenant! Wait, is that the new model!?
Amazing...
It's huge... Is that thing a Gundam?
Armed Base Orchis... combined with the GP-03S Stamen,
this form is the Gundam GP03 Dendrobium, a unit for
base defense in space.
So it's like the Spazer docking with Grendizer...?
What's an "armed base"?
I guess it means it holds weapons... Is that whole thing full of weapons?
Like Grendizer and the Spazer...? But is all of that weapon space...?
Yeah, a walking armory... Like a mobile suit's mobility
with a super robot's weapons attached...
It can't be mass-produced, but...
used like the Big Zam once was, it'd be a real threat to the enemy...
That's... the Unit 3 Major Gato spoke of!?
Bah, it's just for show! Send in the ambush troops!
Are they trying to join up with that!?
I can't let Joe and his gang get any stronger...!
That Gundam's awesome.
All right, the tide's turning our way!
Let's finish off the enemy fast... and go after the colony!
Roger! Man, I want a power-up like that too... Oh my?
Reinforcements!?
Damn...! They were this close!?
I'm not foolish enough to face a new weapon without a plan!
Attack! Crush it here and it won't matter what it is!
An ambush, huh! But we can't let you have your way here!
Isn't this fight getting a little too fierce!? Joe!
Can't be helped!
We're in the same boat-- or rather, on the same moon! We'll see it through!
Here we go, Gundam... GP03...!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. GP03 Dendrobium destroyed
I wanted to destroy the new weapon completely...!
Bah, we've held them up! Withdraw!
Wait, Mashymre!
Judau Ashta, we'll meet again! If you make it in time...
it'll be just before or just after Operation Stardust succeeds!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
We'll make it in time, no matter what...! You'll regret this.
For that, we need to be able to move as fast as we can...
Ngh... Anaheim...
Phew, it's fiiinally over.
Hah! Like we'd lose to a bunch like that...
Still, that's one huge Gundam...
Looks like a Gundam stuck in a Container, I tell ya.
With the GP03... we won't be outmuscled so easily. We can do this.
It's way bigger than the Double Zeta. Phew, that was a lot to deal with...
Anyway, shouldn't we get going soon?
Yes... Joe, Lenny, and Mike, was it?
You've probably heard our situation... No time. We must hurry on.
Yes, we'll explain our situation on the way.
I'm a bit worried about things on the ground, but
since we ended up all the way out here, can't be helped. I'll tag along.
What's with that attitude? You've got a real bad attitude, pal.
Huh? Got a problem?
Is this any time to fight? Think about the situation!
Why does Big Bro always cause extra trouble?
People's personalities don't change that easily.
Still, we should be glad to have strong new allies.
And that ninja robot is on our side, too.
Right, right, now that it's settled, no time to waste.
Looks like we've got more problem children, Captain.
...I'm used to it by now, Lieutenant.
All right, we head for the next destination. All units, return.
Still, those Zeon guys... Always scurrying around in our way...
That just shows how dangerous our actions are to them.
If they're keeping tabs on us, then what we're trying to do
must not be pointless, huh?
Right, right, they're in the middle of a big operation, too.
If they were confident, they wouldn't bother with us.
Earth... my homeland... I'll protect it, no matter what!
